role: R package for in silico digestion, adapter-type selection, and fragment size selection
quantitative_benchmark_status: Direct count-level comparator for shared digest tasks
install_command: mamba install -n radigest-comparison -c conda-forge -c bioconda -y r-seqinr bioconductor-biostrings bioconductor-shortread bioconductor-zlibbioc zlib libzlib && Rscript scripts/comparators/install_simrad_archive.R
limitations: Archived CRAN package; no native coordinate-resolved export comparable to radigest GFF/TSV

role: Python package for ddRAD digest and read/library simulation
quantitative_benchmark_status: Direct only for rsitesearch.py digest-only workflow
version_command: cd external/ddRADseqTools && git rev-parse HEAD && python3 --version
output_metric: fragment count; fragment FASTA length summary; coordinates if recoverable
limitations: Do not compare radigest against full read/PCR/allele-dropout simulation

quantitative_benchmark_status: Direct coordinate-level comparator after motif-bounded output is normalized to cut-coordinate intervals
version_command: cd external/Digital_RADs && git rev-parse HEAD && python3 --version
output_metric: normalized interval set; marker count; length distribution
limitations: Raw output is motif-bounded and must be normalized using enzyme cut offsets; IUPAC motif support and terminal-fragment behavior require separate verification

quantitative_benchmark_status: Limited; digest/locus tally only where output semantics are clear
limitations: Reports RAD loci under simulation assumptions, not raw restriction-fragment intervals

role: Web tool for ddRAD enzyme/size-selection design and sequencing-efficiency prediction
quantitative_benchmark_status: Qualitative unless backend is scripted reproducibly
output_metric: aggregate fragment/bin counts; predicted SNPs; sequencing efficiency
limitations: Web-first; no default coordinate-level CLI benchmark

quantitative_benchmark_status: Limited single-enzyme digest/task comparison if output semantics are verified
limitations: Primarily full GBS population/read simulation, not direct coordinate fragment enumeration

role: Downstream RAD/GBS read-processing and genotyping pipeline
limitations: Not a reference-based digest tool; should not be benchmarked against radigest
